meta.write: NS climb as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. c the field makes, not a c we type. It did not give you c=8.

lemmas.name: B31_saving_readable
lemmas.statement: field c, blob t=0 miss, and path-mean miss are readable together
lemmas.why: Viscous t=0 c ≈ −2. Path means stay negative. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B31a_field_c_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: a field climb at this box closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: The field did not hand us c=8. A missing saving rate is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B31b_offset_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: j_bar > typed j* at t=0 is a continuation argument for classical X
lemmas.why: Packet j_bar ≈ 2.97 versus typed 2 is a static offset. Then j_bar falls. Do not substitute a reading for B11c.

lemmas.name: B31c_ladder_not_a_class
lemmas.statement: viscosity pulling j_bar down is a geometric class that bounds X
lemmas.why: Dissipation owned the barycenter here. That is a reading, not a type. Do not promote a fall to a class.

lemmas.name: B31d_c_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: reading c from the vorticity field is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: A barycenter rate is not ∫‖ω‖_∞. A missing climb is not the max criterion.

lemmas.name: B31e_sketch_leftover
lemmas.statement: matching the prescribed-c sketch closes X
lemmas.why: The field climb is scored. The leftover close on the climb sketch is B21e. Not a bigger FFT. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B31f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring NS climb as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. c is a knob on the estimate: a number you can miss. No Q1. No ε.

next_da_move: Packet geometry is not an a priori (B14d). Stretching budget is not an a priori (B15e). Enstrophy balance is not an a priori (B16e). Coherent blob is not an a priori (B17e). Field occupation is not an a priori (B18e). Field glue is not an a priori (B19e). NS climb is not an a priori (B20e). Climb-sketch leftover is B21e. Finer (n>32) stays a box knob (B22e). Do not spawn n=64. B4c stands. Do not cancel to Φ.
